primary.title: Independence Day 2026: How debt, dependents, healthcare and inflation can change your 'freedom number'
primary.summary: Financial freedom isn’t defined by a fixed ₹5 crore or ₹10 crore corpus. Inflation, debt, dependents, healthcare costs and retirement goals can significantly change the amount you need. Here’s why your personal ‘freedom number’ may be very different from what you expect.
